content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from a single purchased item ID alone. That requires transaction history or an item-to-item association model.

If you provide the purchase data or a mapping of item co-occurrences, I can calculate the top 10.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 2400. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
